body:
## What's Changed
* Puppeteer fetcher - Re-navigation cap must not mean "extract right now" by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4439
* xPath filters - Stop LC_COLLATE deciding what contains() means (#4437), breaks xpath filters by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4438


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/compare/0.60.5...0.60.6

## What's Changed
* Browser fetchers - Report the real status code when Chrome aborts a bodiless error response by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4420
* feat(ui): show count badges in minimal sidebar by @SammySN-car in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4419
* Worker id/available fetcher by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4415
* Browser fetchers - Follow re-navigation, and one content-ready deadline (re-targets #4421 + #4422 at master) by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4426
* Search modal native submit by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4427
* UI - Search modal - keep the search scoped to the tag you were viewing by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4425
* UI - Search modal - fix Enter dismissing the form instead of searching by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4428
* Dockerfile - actually generate locales, price formatting was silently falling back to C by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4429
* Debounce the explicit gc.collect() storm on the watch-check path by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4431
* i18n: Update zh_Hant_TW translations by @LaiYueTing in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4430
* Favicon on/off - Was not actually applying at fetch time by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4432
* Terminate runaway page script before extracting, so a spinning renderer cannot eat the whole fetch by @dgtlmoon in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4433

## New Contributors
* @SammySN-car made their first contribution in https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/pull/4419

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io/compare/0.60.4...0.60.5
